definition: attributed (channel-matched rule, alarm starts within 45 days after onset), chance-corrected with pseudo-onsets on stable elders

ablation.description: Same rules, thresholds and corrected detection definition; personal = each person's own 21-day baseline, population = one pooled norm (median / 1.4826*MAD over all baseline-period calls).

holdout.selection_rule: highest excess (chance-corrected) clinical sensitivity on the development cohort with <= 0.3 all-rule false alarms per person-month; L_red = L_yellow + 1.0
